note: 1.11 moves no figure. It puts 1.10's gap fields on screen, and adds only: gap.weeks (the outlook series) wherever a whole computed item is served (the items list, item pages, the Overview's attention list); gap on every /cart line (without weeks); and eight columns appended to items.csv. cart.csv, suppliers, divergence and kits must be unchanged, and every existing field and CSV cell must be byte-identical; anything else changing is a failure.
reviewed: Written by hand from two in-process captures (stage-check capture through the real router, GET only) on the 26 Aug local copy (allied_dev), the 1.10 tree (98c46f4) then this tree, on the same data, 13 Oct: 28,051 differences, every one an addition apart from release.version 1.10.0 -> 1.11.0: gap.weeks on the 3,064 items in items.json that carry a gap (the 39 with no position have none; no_demand and built_here carry weeks null), on the 14 watched item pages and on the Overview's 15 attention rows; gap on all 133 /cart lines; and 8 new items.csv cells on each of 3,103 rows. Every existing items.csv column is byte-identical (each line is the 1.10 line, a comma and eight cells); cart.csv, suppliers.json, divergence.json, kits-availability.json and every kit page are byte-identical. The entries name only the new fields and columns, so an existing figure moving anywhere still fails.
